### Conditions

| Rough | S263-4 | [code review] No-op capability negotiation failed compatible stores and post-merge reported failure after durable writes |

**Known hazards for future sprints:**
- Do not infer a sprint from roadmap history when active state or an explicit sprint branch is available.
- Preserve every execution tied for newest when timestamps cannot distinguish them.
- Treat optional store mutations as negotiated capabilities and require them only when a transition is actually pending.
- Fail post-merge closeout before writing memories, retro evidence, or sprint state.

### Training Log

| Type | Description | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Lessons | Lifecycle closeout needs both authoritative scope selection and an atomic terminal transition. | Closeout now preserves the caller, filters protected dispositions, and uses adapter-level compare-and-set completion. |
